ELISA.readouts: antigen-specific antibody levels measured by optical density and converted to antibody titres or concentrations

evidence.quote: Anti-Cholera toxin B subunit (CTB) IgG were quantified in serum samples according to a GM1-enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) method adapted from Svennerholm et al. 41 .

evidence.section: Establishing gene-expression signature predictive of HBV vaccine response
evidence.quote: RNA was isolated from PAXgene blood samples according to the manufacturer's instructions. Isolated total RNA samples were assayed for quality metrics (Agilent Bioanalyzer) prior to amplification. Three-hundred and thirty-five samples passing quality control were then amplified using the NuGEN amplification protocol and hybridized to Affymetrix HuRSTA-2a520709 chips (Affymetrix, Santa Clara, CA).

Polychromatic FCM.readouts: frequencies and absolute enumeration of T-cell, B-cell and innate immune cell subsets; median fluorescence intensity of cell surface markers

evidence.quote: Phenotypic analysis of T-cell and innate cell subsets was performed by staining whole blood collected in EDTA Vacutainer tubes. Blood for B-cell analysis was collected in Na-Heparin Vacutainer tubes and further processed by density gradient centrifugation through Ficoll to obtain peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) prior to performing the following steps. Briefly, 50 μl of whole blood was added to TruCount tubes (Becton-Dickinson) for the phenotypic analysis and absolute enumeration of cellular subsets per microliter of blood.

multiplex ELISA.readouts: concentrations of cytokines, chemokines, and inflammatory proteins

evidence.quote: A panel of 45 cytokines/chemokines was measured on the 174 pre-vaccination (V2) samples of the EM131 cohort. Samples were assayed to determine the concentration of inflammatory proteins according to multianalyte profiling protocols established by Rules-Based Medicine (RBM) (Austin, TX). Serum samples were shipped to RBM for analysis using the multiplex ELISA protocol Human Inflammation multianalyte profiling ( Supplementary Table 5b ).

complete blood count.readouts: standard haematologic markers including red blood cell counts

evidence.quote: A panel of 3 standard haematologic markers (complete blood count) was measured on the 174 pre-vaccination samples taken 28 days prior to vaccination (V1) of the EM131 cohort.
